Volume Rendering and 3D Textures | webgpu/webgpu-samples | DeepWiki
Jul 17, 2026The volume rendering sample implements a complete pipeline for visualizing medical imaging data using 3D textures and ray marching shaders. The system processes raw medical volume data, applies various compression techniques, and renders the results using WebGPU's 3D texture capabilities.
